sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Transaction Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models how inclusion list transactions flow from validator submission through storage, deduplication, and retrieval for block building.

nodes.label: Inclusion List Received from Validator
nodes.description: An InclusionList has been received from a validator, containing a set of transactions that should be included in upcoming blocks.

nodes.label: Process Inclusion List
nodes.description: Validate the inclusion list: check it was received before the view freeze deadline, detect equivocations, and store if valid.

nodes.label: Inclusion List Stored in InclusionListStore
nodes.description: Valid inclusion list is stored in the inclusion_lists mapping keyed by (Slot, Root).

nodes.label: Equivocation Detected
nodes.description: The submitting validator has been flagged in the equivocators mapping for sending conflicting inclusion lists.

nodes.label: Get Inclusion List Transactions
nodes.description: Retrieve unique transactions from all valid, non-equivocating, timely inclusion lists for a given slot.

nodes.label: Inclusion List Transactions Available for Block
nodes.description: Deduplicated set of transactions from valid inclusion lists is available for the block builder to include.

edges.label: Validator submits inclusion list via P2P
Valid and timely inclusion list stored
Conflicting inclusion list from same validator
Block builder requests inclusion list transactions

external_entities.name: Inclusion List Validator
external_entities.description: A beacon chain validator that submits an InclusionList specifying transactions that should be included in the next block.

external_entities.name: Block Builder
external_entities.description: Entity building the next block that must consider inclusion list transactions.

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation checks applied to incoming inclusion lists including timeliness, equivocation detection, and the view freeze deadline.

nodes.label: Inclusion List Pending Validation
nodes.description: An inclusion list has been received and needs to pass validation checks.

nodes.label: Check View Freeze Deadline
nodes.description: Verify that the inclusion list was received before the view freeze deadline for the target slot.

nodes.label: Inclusion List Rejected (Past Deadline)
nodes.description: The inclusion list arrived after the view freeze deadline and is rejected.

nodes.label: Check for Equivocation
nodes.description: Verify whether the submitting validator already submitted a different inclusion list for the same (Slot, Root) pair.

nodes.label: Validator Marked as Equivocator
nodes.description: The validator is added to the equivocators mapping; all their inclusion lists for this slot are excluded from get_inclusion_list_transactions.

nodes.label: Inclusion List Accepted and Stored
nodes.description: The inclusion list passes all checks and is added to the store.

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Equivocation Defense
sub_graphs.description: Models the security mechanism that prevents validators from manipulating block contents by submitting conflicting inclusion lists.

nodes.label: Multiple ILs Received from Same Validator
nodes.description: The system has received more than one inclusion list from the same validator for the same (Slot, Root).

nodes.label: Flag Validator as Equivocator
nodes.description: Add the validator index to the equivocators mapping for this slot, neutralizing all their inclusion lists.

nodes.label: Equivocator ILs Excluded from Aggregation
nodes.description: When get_inclusion_list_transactions is called, all inclusion lists from flagged equivocators are excluded from the result.

external_entities.name: Malicious Validator
external_entities.description: A validator attempting to manipulate transaction inclusion by sending conflicting inclusion lists.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define the exact 'view freeze deadline' timing relative to slot boundaries.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the view freeze deadline is defined in the broader EIP-7805 beacon chain spec, likely a fixed offset before the slot start. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The InclusionListStore maps (Slot, Root) to sets of InclusionList, but 'Root' is not explicitly defined as block root or state root.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'Root' refers to the beacon block root (parent or head), consistent with standard Ethereum consensus usage. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block builders are expected to respect inclusion list transactions. The mechanism for enforcing inclusion (vs. merely requesting it) is defined in a separate fork choice or beacon chain spec.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If builders can ignore inclusion lists without penalty, the mechanism provides no censorship resistance, which is its primary purpose.

implicit_assumptions.description: An equivocating validator can only be detected if both conflicting inclusion lists are received by the same node before the view freeze deadline.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If conflicting lists are partitioned across different nodes, some nodes may accept transactions from an equivocator while others exclude them, causing inconsistent block validity judgments.

implicit_assumptions.description: Inclusion lists are propagated via P2P gossip with sufficient speed to reach all nodes before the view freeze deadline.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Late-arriving inclusion lists would be rejected, reducing the effective validator set contributing to censorship resistance.
